title: Ze’ira bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was the host of Rabbi Ami, Rabbi Assi, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi and all the Rabbis of Caesarea, and he said to Rav Yosef, son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, “Son of a lion, come, I will tell you a fine thing your father used to do”: [Yoma 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.9). In [Jerusalem Talmud Yoma, beginning of chapter 8](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yoma.8.1.5), the report names Rabbi Ze’ira bar Chama and Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina in the chain transmitting the teaching in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. In [Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.1.6.5) the statement reads “Ze’irah bar Chama, Yosah son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” and Hyman considers the words “of Rabbi Chanina in the name of” missing.
In [Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 3:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Beitzah.3.8.2), Rabbi Lazar said to Rabbi Ze’ira bar Chama.

notes.text: The linked Jerusalem Talmud Yoma brackets Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina. The Taanit parallel reads Yose son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman proposes restoring words that would make the latter chain read like Yoma.

The linked Bavli names Ze’ira as host and has him address Rav Yosef son of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi as “son of a lion.” [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1153&lang=en) reports the same episode with בר אוריא (“son of Torah”) and records the differing chains in the Yerushalmi.
